messages:
evan_cs: Quick heads-up — Opalux onboarding: their canary is live on our hosted route (eu-west) and we’re seeing tail latency spikes after ~1.5k requests. 95th ~1.2s vs expected ~0.5s. Renewal touchpoint in 6 weeks, want to avoid churn. Looking for proactive perf recs (quant/model swap/routing) + enablement plan.
rachel_se: ack. Any specific payload patterns? short chat completions or long contexts?
evan_cs: Mostly short chat UIs, average tokens per request ~120 but lots of back-and-forth so KV cache growth is frequent. spikes correlate with sequences that hit 1024 token windows.
mina_ml: could be model compute cliff at certain seq length. Quick win: try INT8 quant on dev branch for their workload, and enable KV prefix caching to avoid re-encoding history each call.
rachel_se: do we have a compatible quantized variant for the current model (rw-open-1b-v2)?
mina_ml: we have rw-open-1b-int8-v2 in catalog, verified perf profile for <=1k tokens. quality delta measured on our eval harness: median rouge drop <0.6. good candidate.
ravi_infra: routing suggestion: route eu-west traffic to dedicated pool during their peak hours (08:00-18:00 local) and use a fallback to the cheaper quantized variant with feature-flagged canary at 10%. Also set model-fallback policy on high-queue-depth to immediate switch.
olga_pm: @evan_cs they'll need to approve route changes and potential quality tradeoffs. Can we put a short A/B for Opalux so CS can show expected token savings vs any user-visible regression?
evan_cs: yes. want the AB numbers for the renewal deck. also need a non-invasive plan for their engineers — prefer no SDK changes.
mina_ml: plan: 1) canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% traffic to rw-open-1b-int8-v2 over 24–48h, monitor quality metrics (LM eval set + a small live compare set), 2) enable prefix KV caching with zero SDK changes (server-side opt), 3) update routing policy to prefer dedicated eu-west pool during business hours, 4) add batching tweak (max_batch_delay 5ms) to reduce per-token cost.
rachel_se: sounds good. Can we get expected unit econ delta? ballpark numbers are fine for the deck.
mina_ml: rough: int8 quant -> ~2.3x throughput on same GPU, ~45–55% cost reduction per token. KV caching could reduce token re-encode cost by ~20% depending on convo length. Combined likely 60%+ cost reduction in steady state.
olga_pm: that would be compelling for renewal. any quality/regression risk?
mina_ml: low risk for short chats given our evals, but we'll guard with rollback triggers: if user-complaint rate or a set of signal prompts degrade >1.5x baseline, immediate rollback.
ravi_infra: ops notes: I'll create a canary route and set automatic fallback rules. will also add a scheduled dedicated pool reservation for their peak window — temporary 2-week reservation to prove SLA.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Created canary route: cs-opalux-int8-canary. Initial traffic: 10%. Monitoring hooks: latency, errors, eval-comparison.
evan_cs: thanks. timeline?
ravi_infra: I can have canary + routing policy ready in ~6 hours. Mina can run the first eval and produce a small AB script in the morning.
mina_ml: I'll run evals tonight against Opalux sample set and push metrics to the dashboard. will also prepare a short comparison doc (2 slides) for renewal.
olga_pm: EV: please schedule a 30-min enablement call with Opalux engineers tomorrow to confirm no SDK changes and to capture permission for canary. Also capture any hard latency SLOs they need in the renewal conversation.
evan_cs: booking it now, sending invite. @rachel_se @mina_ml @ravi_infra pls join.
rachel_se: joining.
mina_ml: joining.
ops-bot: [ops-bot] Note: add canary to the incident playbook. Rollback condition threshold set: 1) error rate > 2x baseline OR 2) eval-quality delta worse than threshold.
evan_cs: also capturing customer feedback loop: I'll ask them to flag any user-visible artifacts, and we'll run a targeted evaluation on flagged prompts.
mina_ml: smart — please also request a small sample of 50 recent threads (anonymized) to run offline quality checks.
evan_cs: will request now in the invite.
olga_pm: action items summary: Evan -> schedule enablement + get sample threads. Ravi -> create canary route + reserved pool. Mina -> run evals and slide deck. Rachel -> prepare econ numbers and renewal brief. Ops-bot -> add rollback hooks.
ravi_infra: noted, starting infra tasks now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary route deployed to 10% at 7487655123.
mina_ml: eval run started at 7487655200. pushing baseline vs int8 metrics to dashboard.
evan_cs: thanks team — keep updates here. will present initial results in tomorrow's renewal prep. :thumbsup:
